Question 13

The circle above is centered at C(4,−4) and the point X(−4,2) lies on the circumference. Find the equation of the circle.

a
(x−4)2+(y+4)2=10
b
(x−4)2+(y+4)2=100
c
(x−4)2+(y+2)2=100
d
(x+4)2+(y−4)2=10
e
(x+4)2+(y−2)2=100
Submit
